scope: Explicit pair-table lookup for natural three-summand relations over a rank-one orbit base
statement: In the favorable leading model C=B^2/2+6hr/B^2, an explicit pair-sum table for a signed base and h natural uniform relations has minimum 2 sqrt(3hr) at B=(12hr)^(1/4), which is 4 sqrt(3h/pi) times the negation-aware rho reference sqrt(pi r/4); the statement applies to this lookup method, not arbitrary coordinate solvers.
